newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Livzon 1996 net profit slips 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Livzon 1996 net profit slips 0.8 pct.

text.p: (in millions of yuan unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Earnings per share 0.41 yuan vs 0.40 yuan
Net assets per share 3.70 yuan vs 3.29 yuan
Company name: Livzon Pharmaceutical Group Inc.

Note: The results, published in an annual report in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Monday, were calculated under Chinese accounting standards, except for net profits which were based on international standards.
Based on Chinese standards, the company posted net profits of 81.44 million yuan for 1996 against 80.15 million in 1995.
The firm has proposed no dividend for 1996 but a three-for-10 bonus issue based on 1996 capital surplus, pending approval by shareholders at a meeting on June 17.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Monday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange has announced.
